sourceQuote: If the applicant cannot provide any English competence certificate mentioned above, SAU will evaluate the applicant's English level by checking the English self-introduction video and English result on the transcript.
targetQuote: 若申请者无法提供上述任何英语能力证明，SAU将通过审查英语自我介绍视频及成绩单中的英语成绩来评估申请者的英语水平。
